title: Monitoring cell-surface expression of GPCR by ELISA
author: Elie Besserer-Offroy
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zfef3je

steps.title: Coat 24-well plates with Poly-L-Lysine
steps.instruction: Coat 24-well plates with Poly-L-Lysine in a biological safety cabinet to ensure sterility.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL of 0.1 mg/mL Poly-L-Lysine solution to each well.
Incubate for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Remove the Poly-L-Lysine solution.
Rinse the wells twice with 300 µL of sterile water.
Let the plate dry without a lid under the biological safety cabinet for 20 minutes before seeding cells.

steps.title: Prepare transfection mixture
steps.instruction: Prepare the plasmid transfection mixture in a biological safety cabinet for 3 wells of the 24-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 µL of Opti-MEM into a sterile 5 mL tube.
Add 1.5 µg of plasmidic DNA encoding for the desired HA tagged-GPCR to the tube and mix.
Add 3 µL of P3000 Reagent to the tube and mix.
Add 2.25 µL of Lipofectamine 3000 to the tube, mix, and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare and harvest HEK293 cells
steps.instruction: Prepare HEK293 cells for transfection in a biological safety cabinet.

substeps.instruction: Seed cells at a density of 3 million cells per 10 cm petri dish 48 hours before transfection.
Remove culture media and rinse cells with PBS.
Add 1 mL of 0.25% Trypsin to the 10 cm petri dish and incubate for 2 minutes at 37 °C.
Add 5 mL of complete DMEM (10% FBS, 20 mM HEPES, Penicillin/Streptomycin) to the dish and dissociate cells by pipetting up and down.
Count cells using an automated cell counter (e.g., MOXI Z Mini) or a hemacytometer.

steps.title: Transfect cells and seed plates
steps.instruction: Combine the prepared cells with the transfection mixture and seed onto the coated plates.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 mL of the cell suspension at 150,000 cells/mL to the 5 mL tube containing the plasmidic DNA and mix gently.
Dispense 450 µL of the cell and plasmidic DNA mix into the desired wells of the Poly-L-Lysine-coated 24-well plate.
Incubate at 37 °C in a humidified chamber at 5% CO2 for 48 hours.

steps.title: Fix and block cells
steps.instruction: Fix the cells and block non-specific binding sites on the wet bench.

substeps.instruction: Remove cell culture media and wash each well with 400 µL of PBS.
Fix cells using 400 µL of 3.7 Mass Percent formaldehyde in TBS for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Rinse cells three times with 500 µL of TBS.

Block non-specific sites using 400 µL of 3 Mass Percent non-fat dry milk dissolved in TBS for 30 minutes under gentle orbital agitation (alternatively, use 1 Mass Percent Bovine Serum Albumin in TBS).

steps.title: Incubate with primary antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate the cells with the HRP-linked anti-HA antibody.

substeps.instruction: Remove blocking solution.
Add 250 µL of 1/1000 dilution of HRP-linked anti-HA antibody diluted in 3 Mass Percent non-fat dry milk in TBS.
Incubate for 3 hours under gentle orbital agitation (alternatively, incubate overnight at 4 °C under gentle orbital agitation).
Remove antibody solution and wash each well three times with 500 µL of TBS.

steps.title: Perform colorimetric detection
steps.instruction: Develop the ELISA signal using TMB substrate.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL of room temperature 3, 3′,5, 5′-Tetramethylbenzidine (TMB) Liquid Substrate, Supersensitive, for ELISA.
Incubate under gentle orbital agitation for 2 to 15 minutes until the positive control turns intense blue.
Stop the TMB reaction by adding 250 µL of 2 Molarity (M) Hydrochloric Acid (HCl).

steps.title: Quantify expression
steps.instruction: Measure the absorbance and normalize the results.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of the colorimetric reaction to a flat-bottom transparent 96-well plate.
Read the absorbance at 450 nm using a multimode plate reader (e.g., Mithras2 LB943).

Normalize the results as a percentage of expression compared to the positive control using the formula: y = (x - x_min) / (x_max - x_min), where x is the sample OD 450nm, x_min is the mean OD 450nm of the negative control, and x_max is the mean OD 450nm of the positive control.
